Main story is short and took me about 25 hours (which got me to about lvl 40 by the final mission) and the DLC will get you about 5 extra hours of playtime spread out into 5 main quests and some of the most fun side quests in the game (pretty much required to be at level for DLC missions) The side quests in the main story are quite stale and all follow the same formula of "go kill a robot and bring me a rare part." But i even found myself enjoying these side quests due to how addicting the combat loop is. When approaching a new monster you have to scan it with your focus to learn its strengths and weaknesses to defeat it. The new take on ubisoft towers in the form of tallnecks is nice.
The story and game play are very unique. Aloy and the story are amazingly written and have become one of my top 5 games of all time. You will not be disappointed and its certainly worth the money.
Great game. Graphics are great, story line is great and the game mechanics are great. definitely worth playing. Hurry up and port Horizon FW!!
Sony took their ball and went home. Let them. They don't want to entertain PC players or fund their largest IP's. Can't recommend a publisher that treats its customers or developers that way.

Great story.

BUT no one needs so many boring and identical side quests. It would have been much better if there had been a minimum amount of work involved in these quests, even if it meant shortening the main quest.

I would recommend it to anyone who had fun with Far Cry and Assassins Creed series. There is a decent main story, a lot of side stories, and a unique combat system. In the early game you need to avoid almost each machine, but with the time you learn their strong sides and weaknesses.

Nice open world game with a good story.
Different types of machines in different type of environment, weather conditions and different types of weapons to destroy each of the machines.
Very good graphics with good optimization felt smooth.
DLC is also included which is worth completing as well.
Got 100% progression on both base game and DLC.

Awesome game I really liked it.

Great open-world game with lots to do. Unique take that pulls you in. A nice progression as you work your way through the world. Definitely times when you are out matched and have to think fast to overcome the odds. Sneaking is so so but still enjoyable.

I was amazed at how long it took to complete.

I recommend this game.

Got the game on sale. (I usually only buy games at sale)
I have 100% game completion.
Before starting the game I was not quite rather heavily doubtful of it having a good story as I usually find stories containing
annihilation, machines, AI full of loopholes but swear to god this was epic. Bit by bit, drop by drop things started to make sense and at the end of it what became of a doubtful story was a journey to remember for ages.
For me this game has joined the club which itself dictates the standard for other games.
Great game.

On normal difficulty. Harder difficulty equates to more enemy HP and damage. Lazy game making. it's okay.

Great game! The atmosphere is on point and the story is brilliant. I really enjoyed the game mechanics with all the different weapons and ways to approach a fight. The graphics and animations are just stunning.
I'd recomend it to everyone who likes single player rpg's with a greate narrative and if you fancy the challange, try out hardmode. I think that gave little bit extra on the combats. Hope to see Forbidden West come to Steam as well :)
Fun game, great story and characters. only snag when you hit level 60 and attempting to complete the skill tree. but beyond that, tons of fun.

Beautiful with an interesting premise, decent combat.

But ultimately boring and tedious with protagonist that somehow has less personality than Geralt of Rivia.
Stealth is unwieldy and broken at worst, typical openworld problems galore, locations are just placed here and there with no further thought put to how to actually communicate their existence to player far away so everything just has quest markers to turn your brain off, use of fast travel is near essential cause the distanced between are so large filled with absolutely nothing interesting. constant item management even mid combat.

Rarely I'm to drop a game before finishing it but I just can't get into this.

This game replaced my life for the hours I played it. I could write several essays on the wonder that overcame me, but the short of it is:
Gameplay: stressful at all the right times, nothing outstandingly original but everything is well done. The puzzles (specifically the optional ones) are excellent. My first game on a controller and it taught me very well.

Story: It gets better the more you discover. It's like an onion, there are so many layers. I thought I was just here for a good time, some laser raptors and pretty landscapes but OH MY there's more.
Aloy's personnality and story is so deep and well-thought out, I adored it here and am continuing to adore it in the Forbidden West.

Graphics: Already gorgeous as is (and I see the Remastered is even better), I have a special place in my heart for the landscapes. I definitely have several hours of gameplay time just staring into the (heh) Horizon.
Not sure why they base movements around and invisible pivot. Prob because of console controllers. I had to crank up the look speed sliders playin on a pc, but other than that perfect game.

Game is good, we know this already.

For me the PC port has been running fine for 40+ hours of gameplay including time spent multitasking, tabbing in and out, etc.

Solid 60+ FPS with a 2060 and 3600, no real issues.

Beautiful graphics, looks like a good story line from what I saw. Unfortunately horrible to play keyboard and mouse. Unable to acclimate to the xbox controller. The controls don't make sense and the tutorial that gets you started misses basic functions for the keyboard mouse player. Forced to spend time just trying to get the basic functions explained from google searches to get through the basic tutorial. Missing was even info to swap weapons from the spear and fighting with it vs the bow. The game seems to expect that the player knows what to do next without any prompts during the learning process. A beautiful game with a failure to communicate or interface for anything but the original console it was made for.

It's good to see console exclusives come to PC.

I've already completed this game on PS4, but it feels much better to be able to aim with mouse. Specially since there is a lot of aiming in this game.

What I love most about HZD is the post-apocalytic world it builds, and how fully detailed it is.
A world crawled with dangerous animal-like machines, each with it's own behavior, combat style and weaknesses (and cool sounds btw).

Combat is fun and engaging, it can be really challenging too. You won't get much damage output by just smashing melee attacks, instead the game gives you a wide variety of weapons and mechanics to take down machines,. It puts you in the role of a hunter, taking down big foes feels rewarding.

I'd recommend this to any person who wants to experience a great open-world RPG with an original combat system and a rich world to explore.

(One of?) The best story-driven action rpg with a unique take on the post-apo world. Unforgettable

In terms of crashes - had only two. Update your drivers guys and you shall pass!

It's been weeks, I've tried everything and no matter what I can't get past 15 minutes of game play without the game crashing.
They made one patch, nothing changed. Sadly I passed my 2 hour mark for a refund so I just have an expensive unplayable game in my library. Don't buy.

While this game can be a bit wonky at times, it is an amazing game. There's not much about this game that I can say that hasn't already been said. As I wait for Forbidden West to eventually be ported I'll leave you with a story. In 2018 I had really bad depression and this just happened to be the first game I played, beat, and 100% after being discharged from the hospital. Ironic that it would be a game that's built on the beauty of world after it was destroyed. Not only that but throughout my high school years I always wanted to make video games. Playing this game for the first time back then on PS4 I got hit with a wave of pure emotion. This was the game I always wanted to create. And to find it shortly after my world should have ended really spoke to me. This game will forever stay in my list of all time favorites because of it's beautiful story and world, as well as me discovering it at the perfect time in my life to really bring me out of the darkest period of my life.

The Positives - Great art design and graphics, plenty of content and a real bang for your buck.

The Neutral - Combat can feel janky at times. Not bad, just some encounters seem to be more thought out then others. Story is serviceable but for me was not all that interesting. Characters can come across rather bland or one note. RPG mechanics feel half baked.

The Bad - Game is far from optimized. Frame rate can be all over the place and the advertised ultra wide settings will still leave you with black bars on both the left and right sides of the screen instead of a complete fill.

Conclusion - A good game with some noticeable flaws. I have also played this game on the PS4 and this is definitely a step up from the console but not worth buying at full price. if you have played that version in the past but still want to see how gorgeous this game can be on advanced hardware I'd wait for a sale.

7/10

Horizon Zero Dawn is a fantastic game limited by a pretty bad PC port. I was surprised to see how much of the story in this game is truly interesting and well written. The world building is exceptional for a open world game of this Ubi em up style. You want to know more.

What is less stellar is that the PC version is really quite bad, even after five or six patches now. The primary issue is poor performance, as well as for me, quite severe stutter. I have tried SpecialK which makes the go from stuttering every 2-5 seconds (yup, it can be that bad) to about perhaps once or twice a minute. It is at it's worse when traversing the world.

As a comparison, Red Dead 2, another open world game plagued by a bad PC port, runs immensely better. Like day and night better. I can run RDR2 in 1800p 60FPS, looks stunning, with perfect framepacing. Horizon is not capable of anything near this, and runs with garbage framepacing with occasional spikes (the stutters) in 1440p 60. 4K just makes the game tank. It's also a very unsharp game, so you need to add sharpening, which does make the ugly texture stand out a bit further though. To be fair though, RDR2 was almost unplayable for like six months. Perhaps Horizon will get as good as this, but in my opinion the port just isn't finished.

So - great game, despite the stuttering.

Coming as a Fallout 4, and Witcher 3 lover, this is a great upgrade in terms of mechanics, style of quest, and difficulty. Only been playing it for a month or so, and already have 64 hrs in it. I'm a 37 yr old father of 2 with full time job. I'm playing WAYYY too much 😂😂😂

The graphics, music, voice acting. Amazing. So many times i find myself just hanging out in random sections of the game and just looking and watching.

I love this game! You can choose how to kill the machines; by stealth, high up or just attacking them upfront. The graphics are outstanding and the story is very intriguing. I definitely recommend this game!!!! :D
Its realistic and fun, but you need to be in the mood to wait, its a long game but fun if
good game, but why they need so much data collection only for fixing bug for future updates then forces me to accept it?

Good game. Super pretty.
But I am surprised it got such great reviews. Took a bit of work to actually get into it. In many ways very boring and it has Robot Dinosaurs! How can you be bored with robot dinosaurs?
But still I enjoyed it and finished but certainly no interest in any sequels.

I have a powerful machine and played it years after release but it certainly made it work, the heat climbs and the fans whirr.
The archery combat is good fun.
The melee combat is terrible. Dinosaurs can attack you through buildings. Just assume if get close you'll die and work on shooting and trapping. Which is odd as the hit locations for the archery are excellent. Shoot off that plate then the robot heart inside etc.
Pacing is odd. Sometime you just have to accept you are in for 30mins of not really skip-able cut scenes. Usually pretty and the story is ok but still if you are in the mood to shoot chicken robots in the face and have to hear the story of... whatever. Well just accept that is where the game is at.

Lot of other similar style stealth, open world that do everything better, eg shadow of mordor.

So sure I'll say yes to recommend but
certainly would not get if not on a good discount.
Great game. But the Idiots at Sony have doubled the price of this game after the news of a remaster. do not buy. get a game key elsewhere at the original price (19.99 USD)

Horizon Zero Dawn Complete Edition is an absolute marvel of gaming excellence. From its breathtaking landscapes to its immersive storyline, this game delivers an unparalleled experience that will leave you captivated from start to finish.

The Complete Edition offers an abundance of content, including the base game and its exceptional expansion, The Frozen Wilds. Exploring the vast open world as Aloy, a skilled hunter in a post-apocalyptic world overrun by robotic creatures, is nothing short of awe-inspiring.

The gameplay mechanics are flawlessly executed, blending action-packed combat with strategic elements as you utilize Aloy's arsenal of weapons and tools to overcome challenges. The depth of character development and the richness of the narrative keep you invested in Aloy's journey, as she uncovers the mysteries of her past and the secrets of the world around her.

Visually stunning and accompanied by a hauntingly beautiful soundtrack, Horizon Zero Dawn is a testament to the creativity and craftsmanship of its developers. Whether you're scaling towering cliffs or engaging in intense battles against mechanical behemoths, every moment is a testament to the game's attention to detail and dedication to delivering an unforgettable experience.

In conclusion, Horizon Zero Dawn Complete Edition is an absolute must-play for any gaming enthusiast. Its blend of breathtaking visuals, compelling storytelling, and engaging gameplay make it a true masterpiece that stands among the greatest games of its generation.

Recomended to play 5/5

Horizon Zero Dawn had an interesting world, relatively unique archery based combat, and interesting upgrade systems.
I think many of the choices RE story and upgrades suffered from obvious best choices but I didn't really mind it in the scope of the game.

This is one of the few solo games that immersed me enough into the world that I ended up reading all of the flavor texts and supplemental logs throughout the story.

Horizon Zero Dawn was my first Playstation Game, now that I have played Marvel's Spider-Man, Days Gone and God of War. Horizon Zero Dawn although a Good Game, I feel it loses Lustre compared to Sony's Other Exclusives on PC. The most notable thing about Horizon Zero Dawn is the World/Environment Design. Taking the Concept of Man returning to the Era of Tribes and the World is littered with Dinosaurs like Machines. The Game's unique Retro Futuristic World is its main attraction, Then coming to the Story, which is good but not exactly a masterpiece. I feel Other Sony Exclusives have better Stories in offer. I did not regret giving this game my time. A Solid 8 Out Of 10 From Me.

One of the best games I've ever played! I forgot to write my review when I first beat it, but now that I've beat it again I remembered. Horizon Zero Dawn is also the first game I ever got all the achievements for. I will always remember this masterpiece, and I can't wait for Forbidden West!
Awesome game, it has a incredibly interesting storyline, discovering and fighting new machines is entertaining and on top of that it's also very pretty.

Buggy as hell. Have a fairly high end pc and HZD crashes roughly every 30 minutes or so. I could live with that, but with the absence of a quick save feature, I'll probably be shelving this game and playing something that is actually stable. Avoid buying until it's fully patched and maybe wait until a seasonal sale before risking it.

For context, I can't recall another game I've played in the past several years having the performance issues this one does.

I love it.

The game has a very good story paired with a great engine this game is defiantly on my top five. The graphics are absolutely beautiful. I played the on keyboard exclusively and loved it ! Negative:
- Dialogue and the animations are very wonky/awkward a lot of the time.
- Character interactions are really stiff and it doesn't flow very well.
- Voice acting isn't good with most of the characters.
- Side quests are usually not very interesting and mostly just some boring fetch quests
- Most characters are not very interesting or memorable

Neutral:
+ Story seems to be fine for the most part, but nothing amazing or groundbreaking.
+ Story does get more interesting when you progress, its just executed a bit poorly.

Positive:
+ Very interesting premise with a unique world
+ Gameplay is nice and smooth, very fun
+ Game world is big and it looks nice
+ DLC content has most of the negative points improved/fixed (animations, voice acting, faces etc)
+ DLC overall is actually way better than the base content

With DLC the game is a strong 7/10.

I lost my complete game progress in this game twice, and while I'm still mad, I returned to the game both times. That probably says a thing or two about how much I like the game. I'm still pissed though

Honestly one of the few games which has a beautiful scenery aspect paired with free roam and exploration and to top it off, the story lines in this game is absolutely well written and animated! All in all, this is truly one of the games i enjoyed most till this date.
One of the best games of all time for me. Amazing story and amazing gameplay. 10/10
I really like the story and world building of this game. Aloy is also a great protagonist, equal parts smart and sassy but in an endearing way.

reason.text: Negative reviews in this period focus on the removal of the original game and a PSN account requirement that blocks some regions.
Reviews tie this to a remaster that requires PSN, and a PCGamesN news headline reports delisting beginning ahead of the remake.

lines.F2: Oct 2024: 69% positive across 624 reviews (192 negative), against a usual 91% positive and 56 negative a month

news.title: Horizon Zero Dawn delisting begins ahead of remake

tldr.text: Very Positive (89%): players love the story and characters.
Bugs and crashes are a leading complaint, and some players will not recommend the game until they are fixed.

details.text: Recent reviews are about as positive as the all-time score, at 87%.
Players with the fewest hours are far less positive than long-time players, who are the most positive group.
